description: probe-image-size version 7.4.0 has a regular expression denial of service (ReDoS) vulnerability in the lib/common/svg_header.js file. This flaw allows remote unauthenticated attackers to cause event loop blocking by supplying specially crafted SVG files with an unclosed internal subset followed by many ']' characters. The vulnerability triggers quadratic backtracking in probe.sync, probe(stream), or probe(url), leading to repeated stalls in the event loop.
